profile_text: As a leading manufacturer and distributor of cameras, lenses, and other optical products in Germany, this subsidiary of Nikon Europe B.V. has experienced significant growth, with a 45.5% increase in employees since its baseline. The company's success can be attributed to its strong presence in the German market, where it provides a wide range of high-quality optical products to meet the demands of photographers and other professionals. With 160 employees as of 2024, the company continues to expand its operations and solidify its position in the industry.
